Alert: You gain +5 to initiative. You can't be surprised and enemies don't get advantage from being hidden from you.
Athlete: You gain +1 STR, DEX, or CON. Your jumping distance doubles. You can take the Dash action as a bonus action once per long rest.
Actor: You gain +1 CHA. You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as someone else. You can mimic speech and sounds.
Charger: After using Dash, you can make a melee attack as a bonus action. Your charge deals extra damage.
Crossbow Expert: You ignore loading property. Attacks within 5 feet don't cause disadvantage. You can attack with a hand crossbow as a bonus action.
Defensive Duelist: Using a finesse weapon, you can add your proficiency bonus to AC as a reaction when attacked.
Dual Wielder: You can dual-wield without penalty. You gain +1 to AC while wielding two weapons. You can draw weapons as part of your attack.
Dungeon Delver: You have advantage on Perception and Investigation checks in dungeons. You detect pit traps and secret doors more easily.
Durable: When you roll a Hit Die to recover HP, you always minimum +2 HP. Your CON HP increases by 2 and +1 per level.
Great Weapon Master: After you hit with a greatsword or greataxe, you can bonus action attack. Heavy weapons deal +10 damage on critical hits.
Healer: You can use Healer's Kit to restore additional HP. As an action, you can stabilize creatures with 0 HP.
Heavy Armor Master: You gain +3 STR or 19 STR. While wearing heavy armor, you aren't slowed and attacks don't gain advantage against you.
Inspiring Leader: As an action, you can grant temporary HP to up to 6 creatures within 30 feet who can see you.
Keen Mind: You gain +1 INT. You always know which way is north and can't get lost. You can accurately recall anything you've seen in the past month.
Lightly Armored: You gain +1 STR, DEX, or CON. You gain proficiency with light armor.
Linguist: You gain +1 INT. You know three extra languages. You can write and speak all languages you know.
Lucky: You gain 3 luck points. When you roll, you can spend 1 point to reroll. Attackers near you can reroll their attack.
Mage Slayer: You have advantage on concentration saves. As a reaction, you can force spellcasters within 30 feet to reroll.
Magic Initiate: You learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from a class's spell list. You can cast it once per long rest.
Martial Adept: You learn two battle master Maneuvers and gain one superiority die (d6).
Medium Armor Master: You gain +3 STR or 19 STR. Wearing medium armor doesn't give disadvantage on Stealth. You can add DEX above +2.
Mobile: Your speed increases by 10 feet. Difficult terrain doesn't slow you. When you Disengage, enemies can't opportunity attack you.
Mounted Combatant: Your mount can't be knocked prone, stunned, or paralyzed. Attacks against your mount have disadvantage.
Observant: You gain +1 INT or WIS. You can read lips. You notice creatures within 30 feet even hidden.
Polearm Master: You can use a bonus action for a polearm's reach attack. Enemies entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.
Resilient: Choose one ability score. You gain +1 to it and proficiency in its saves.
Ritual Caster: You learn three ritual spells from any class list. You must have a ritual book if the spell is in your book.
Sentinel: Opportunity attacks have extra 10 feet range. You can make attacks against creatures that attack your allies.
Sharpshooter: Ranged attack penalties don't apply to your longbow/shortbow attacks. You can make ranged attacks at long range without disadvantage.
Shield Master: You gain +2 AC from shields. As a bonus action, you can knock prone creatures that fail saves near you. Dexterity saves against effects have +2.
Skilled: Gain proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice.
Skulker: If you have no enemies in line of sight, you can Hide as a bonus action. Silencing yourself doesn't end you.
Spell Sniper: Ranged spell attacks have no disadvantage. Spell range increases by half. You can cast spells as rituals without time increase.
Tavern Brawler: You gain +1 STR, CON, or DEX. Unarmed attacks deal 1d4. You can make opportunity attacks with grapples.
Tough: Your HP increase by your level x 2. This stacks with other HP improvements.
War Caster: You have advantage on concentration saves. You can cast spells as opportunity attacks. You can perform somatic components while holding weapons/shields.
Weapon Master: You gain +1 STR, DEX, or CON. Proficiency with all weapons. You can draw two weapons as one attack.
